title: Display Charger IDs on the Map Using Map Monitor Quick Select
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI Map Monitor Quick Select icon “View Charger Ids” to overlay unique charger IDs on the live map for charger-related identification/debugging.
when_to_use: When you need to identify which charger location corresponds to a specific charger ID during charger-related troubleshooting/identification.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the RMS map overlay steps to confirm charger IDs are visible and uniquely labeled on the live map.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) with Map Monitor Quick Select panel

access_required: Access to RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui)

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Quick Select panel showing the “View Charger Ids” icon and related Quick Select icons (View all AGV active paths, View Station Ids, View Charger Ids, and object selection icons).

steps.title: Open RMS Map Monitor Quick Select panel
steps.purpose: Get to the Map Monitor Quick Select controls where the charger ID overlay can be enabled.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), open the Map Monitor view and locate the left-side “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel.
steps.expected_result: The left-side “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel is visible with Quick Select icons including “View Charger Ids”.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Quick Select icons on the left panel, including “View Charger Ids”.
steps.failure_condition: The Map Monitor Quick Select panel is not visible, or the “View Charger Ids” icon is not present in the panel.

actions.label: Locate Quick Select panel
actions.exact_action: Locate the left-side “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The left-side panel contains icons including “View Charger Ids”.

steps.title: Enable the “View Charger Ids” overlay
steps.purpose: Turn on the map overlay that displays unique charger identifiers.
steps.instruction: In the Map Monitor Quick Select panel, click the “View Charger Ids” icon.
steps.expected_result: The map updates to display charger IDs at charger locations (unique IDs for all chargers in the system).
steps.healthy_condition: Charger locations on the map show unique charger IDs after selecting “View Charger Ids”.
steps.failure_condition: Charger IDs do not appear on the map after selecting “View Charger Ids”.

actions.label: Click View Charger Ids
actions.exact_action: Click the “View Charger Ids” icon in the Quick Select panel.

stop_or_escalate_if: If charger IDs do not appear when the overlay is selected, stop and escalate for further RMS map/overlay troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “View Charger Ids” shows all chargers’ unique IDs on the map; if there are 10 chargers, 10 unique IDs are shown.

steps.title: Verify unique charger IDs display on the map
steps.purpose: Confirm the overlay is working and that charger IDs are uniquely labeled for identification.
steps.instruction: On the map, verify that charger locations display unique charger IDs.
steps.expected_result: Charger locations on the map show unique charger IDs after selecting “View Charger Ids” (e.g., if there are 10 chargers, 10 unique IDs are shown).
steps.healthy_condition: Each charger location has a visible charger ID label, and the set of IDs corresponds to the number of chargers in the system.
steps.failure_condition: Charger locations show no IDs, missing IDs, or non-unique/incorrect labeling.

actions.label: Check charger ID labels
actions.exact_action: On the map, verify that charger locations display unique charger IDs.

stop_or_escalate_if: If charger IDs do not display when the overlay is selected, stop and escalate for deeper RMS map/overlay troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “View Charger Ids” shows all chargers’ unique IDs on the map; if there are 10 chargers, 10 unique IDs are shown.

success_criteria: After clicking “View Charger Ids”, charger locations on the RMS map display unique charger IDs.
healthy_conditions: Charger locations on the map show unique charger IDs after selecting “View Charger Ids”.
failure_conditions: Charger IDs do not appear on the map after selecting “View Charger Ids”.
escalation_guidance: If charger IDs do not display when the overlay is selected, stop and escalate for further RMS map/overlay troubleshooting.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: “View Charger Ids” shows all chargers’ unique IDs on the map; if there are 10 chargers, 10 unique IDs are shown.
